items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) will not practice Friday and is listed as doubtful vs Broncos; Sean McVay believes barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip injury, no practice Fri after prior DNPs; McVay optimistic for W4.
items.implication: Adams elevated to WR1 role again; TEs/Atwell also benefit.

items.text: Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR; week-to-week after imaging/specialists, only ruled out this weekend vs Seahawks. Aiming return ASAP.
items.why: Dislocated elbow; consensus no IR after eval.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP second straight day Thursday; status very much in doubt/likely miss vs Colts per reports.
items.why: Hamstring, no practice Wed-Thu; Rapoport 'very much in doubt'.
items.implication: Schultz continues elevated target share (28-30% prior).

items.text: Without Jayden Reed: Christian Watson 45 routes, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% targets so far.
items.why: High route shares in first game sans Reed (neck/back).
items.implication: Watson/Golden clear top options; start with confidence.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets (8% share) through 3 games. TPRR 33% London off / 17% on last two seasons.
items.why: Low route participation and target share especially with London on field.
items.conflict: Prior big games don't override current low usage.

items.text: Nick Bosa (calf) expected miss few weeks including vs Cardinals; 49ers leaning not to place on IR due to limited spaces.
Zay Flowers (hamstring) among those who may miss Sunday; returned practice Friday but still unlikely per beats.
items.why: Hamstring from W1; limited progress before Brazil trip.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth tested in international game.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% team tgt share last week sans Collins; IND allows 4th-most yds to TEs.
items.why: Elevated role if Collins out + matchup.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D, high volume expected.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% tgt share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara active; role not there (RB37 util).
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps, 5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g to RBs (3.2 ypc).
